messages:
maria: starting change window for svc-embed v2 rollout. deploybot preflight in ~2m. watching embed-route SLOs (p95, 5xx). pinning v2 to riser-03 for the initial ramp.

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: starting preflight for svc-embed:v2 -> riser-03. smoke + infra checks + observability snapshot queued.

observability-bot: OBS SNAPSHOT: baseline p95=310ms p99=870ms 5xx=0.11% error_budget=4.5% snapshot: https://obs.redwood/svc-embed/snapshots/1708520011

ryan: confirm pause thresholds?

maria: pause if p95 > 450ms OR 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 2m OR error budget drop >2% within 5m. region-local spikes -> immediate hold.

tara: seeing p99 spikes ~1.3s in eu-west-1 as traffic starts. small tail.

observability-bot: REGION SNAP: eu-west-1 p95=420ms p99=1300ms 5xx=0.18% -> correlates with cache miss spike. trace: https://traces.redwood/trace/aa12

sre-lead: if kv/cache miss rate >2x baseline during ramp, hold and investigate kv path. prefer pause + fix over full rollback unless 5xx breaches.

deploy-bot: ACTION: ramp plan rp-2026-03 shifting traffic toward 30% over 5m. current=18%.

jules: redis timeouts increasing, kv-cache misses ~3x. traces show higher latencies on kv-get. could be new config or cold cache.

maria: pausing at 18% to avoid hitting p95 threshold. no rollback yet. need quick config tweak to prefer local fallback. @ryan can you push hotpatch?

ryan: pushing hotpatch svc-embed:cfg-hotfix-1708520150 -> updating cache policy.

``` 
# hotfix
cache.policy=prefer_cached
cache.fallback=soft_miss
```

Changing to:

```
cache.policy=prefer_kv
cache.fallback=aggressive_prefetch
```

ryan: hotpatch applied, restarting pods in riser-03 (graceful).

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: hotfix rollout in progress. will re-run smoke + observability snapshot after pods come up.

observability-bot: POST-PATCH SNAP: p95=340ms p99=910ms 5xx=0.08% kv-miss back to baseline snapshot: https://obs.redwood/svc-embed/snapshots/1708520198

maria: good. resuming ramp to 60% but keep tight watch for 10m. add cache-policy tweak to release notes and changelog (pause + hotfix).

sre-lead: add temporary alert: kv-cache-miss-rate >1.5x baseline during ramps -> page SRE and auto-pause ramp.

jules: added playbook entry and a postmortem checklist item referencing rp-2026-03 pause.

maria: thanks all. continuing ramp, will re-evaluate at 60%. :thumbsup:
